steps.say: Open the accounts dashboard — eight seeded accounts across four rule packs
Tick 'simulate a US business afternoon' so the recording is correct regardless of what time it's actually filmed
Check a consented, in-window account — CLEARED
Check an account with no consent on file — BLOCKED: NO_CONSENT
Place the cleared call through CALL-E and see the outcome land in the row
Verify the audit chain — every decision and call outcome, hash-chained
Tamper one entry and verify again — the chain visibly breaks at the exact entry
